test_robot_joint_positions: test that the robot moved to the desired joint positions within tolerance
run_move_to_joint_positions: run the robot to move to absolute or delta joint positions over a set time
run_go_home: run the robot to return to its home pose over a specified time
run_joint_impedance_control: run joint impedance control by starting impedance mode and updating desired positions in a loop
check_episode_log: check the state log from a robot movement episode for expected length and timestamps
